reasoning: Ohio’s statewide Cook Partisan Voting Index is R+6. In the last 45 days, the most relevant Ohio Senate polling/news points to a toss-up with small and conflicting margins: a Fox News poll showed Brown ahead by 8 points, AARP showed Brown ahead by 3 points, Emerson showed Husted ahead by 6 points, and Decision Desk HQ’s average had Brown ahead by 1 point; the balance of evidence supports a current race margin of roughly EVEN to D+1 rather than a clear partisan lead.

sources.name: Fox News via Newsweek
sources.details: Fox News poll of 1,015 registered Ohio voters found Sherrod Brown leading Jon Husted 53% to 45%.

sources.name: AARP / Fabrizio Ward & Impact Research
sources.details: AARP survey reported Brown ahead of Husted 48% to 45% among Ohio voters.

sources.name: Emerson College Polling
sources.details: Emerson College Polling found Husted leading Brown 50% to 44%.

sources.name: Decision Desk HQ
sources.details: Decision Desk HQ said Brown held a slim 47% to 46% edge in its Ohio Senate average.

sources.name: VoteHub / Newsweek
sources.details: Newsweek reported VoteHub’s Ohio Senate polling average had shifted to a 0.9-point Democratic lead.

sources.name: Cook Partisan Voting Index
sources.details: Cook Political Report’s statewide partisanship for Ohio is R+6.
